verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Intel serves an llms.txt at intel.com (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for the vendor that make this processor. The file is company-wide ("Intel Corporation"), and the pack does not show that it covers the Core Ultra 9 285K's specifications or developer documentation. Missing for 10: evidence the llms.txt indexes 285K-specific spec and developer docs, any product-level agent-oriented documentation, and hands-on corroboration that agents can use it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.intel.com/llms.txt # Intel Corporation
